meta_description: Platinum Gas provides expert gas engineering and boiler services across Preston. Gas Safe registered, emergency callouts available. Call 07854 718827 today.
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdown at the weekend? Platinum Gas responds to emergencies across Preston within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Gas Engineering Services in Preston
services_subhead: From routine servicing to emergency repairs and new installations, Platinum Gas handles all your gas and heating needs with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Boiler packed in? We attend emergency callouts 24/7 across Preston. Most faults diagnosed and fixed the same day, keeping your home warm and your bills under control.

services.title: Annual Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Keep your boiler efficient and safe with a yearly check-up. We spot small problems before they become expensive, and your warranty stays valid.

services.title: New Boiler Installation
services.desc: Modern condensing boilers cut heating costs by up to 40%. We handle the full installation, paperwork, and warranty — with no disruption to your home.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full heating system design and installation from pipes to radiators. We build systems that heat your home evenly and run efficiently for years.

services.title: Gas Safety Checks
services.desc: Landlords and property managers: we carry out gas safety inspections and issue compliance certificates to protect your tenants and your liability.

services.title: Radiator Replacement & Repairs
services.desc: Cold spots on your radiators? We replace corroded units and bleed air locks, restoring even heat throughout your home.

about_pullquote: I started Platinum Gas because I saw homeowners being let down by cowboys who vanish after the sale.
about_para_1: Platinum Gas was founded 15 years ago on a simple promise: turn up on time, do the job right, and charge a fair price. We've built our reputation across Preston by treating every customer's home like our own. Every engineer carries full parts inventory and diagnostic kit, so most jobs are completed the same day—no follow-up visits, no surprises.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because they trust us. We're Gas Safe registered, insured, and we stand behind our work with written guarantees. Word of mouth from satisfied homeowners is how we've grown—and it's the best testimony we could ask for.
reviews_heading: What Preston Homeowners Say About Platinum Gas

reviews.text: Our boiler died on a Friday evening in December—nightmare timing. Called Platinum Gas at 7pm and they were here by 8. Fixed it that same night. Wouldn't be without them now.

reviews.text: Had my annual service done last month. The engineer was thorough, explained everything clearly, and didn't try to sell me unnecessary bits. Great value and a company you can actually trust.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: New boiler installation from start to finish. Professional throughout, on schedule, and the paperwork was all sorted. Three months in and the heating runs beautifully. Highly recommend.
